key_claims.claim: FIGO 2023 staging criteria reduce MRI-pathology concordance in endometrial cancer because molecular subtype information is inaccessible to preoperative imaging.
AI-generated anatomical overlays during pelvic lymph node dissection significantly improve surgeons' sensitivity and specificity for identifying critical structures.
PSMA-11 PET/CT leads to more frequent alterations in salvage radiotherapy planning than fluciclovine PET/CT in post-prostatectomy biochemical recurrence.
Machine learning-derived body composition metrics from coronary CTA independently predict 10-year mortality and myocardial infarction.
AI models applied to H&E biopsy slides can predict neoadjuvant therapy response with AUCs of 0.70–0.90, but external validation and methodological standardization remain inadequate.
